scope: R005 v0.3.1 isolated paired supplement entry and synthetic tests; read-only code review, no mathematical request.
summary: 当前薄入口未发现会多发题、重用旧session/旧release或绕过共享runner的阻断问题。其准备/冻结/释放门禁、双方同字节单题投影、每模型一次顺序提交、运行身份/原始事件/隔离证据核对及未知计数处理可复用现有合同。归档与离线复算仍是文档事先声明的后续工作，不应把当前入口说成完整端到端已验收；原41/82整体归档器不能直接运行补测。

checked_contracts.evidence: single_catalog enforces one suite row, one case entry, cases=[MG-R005], case+entry version 0.3.1, written kind, repository-contained root, matching full Suite fingerprint. Actual execution passes ids=[MG-R005]; synthetic runner test confirms other suite cases are not submitted.

prepare freezes a shared Suite snapshot and derives one request/message with shared candidate_message, writes one payload for both fresh session preparations. finalize and cli_adapter recheck both request and message SHA256 plus input/task.md; references remain outside candidate projection.

checked_contracts.contract: Fresh sessions, once each, separate release
checked_contracts.evidence: Dedicated new /private/tmp root; prerequisites reject overlap with the original runtime and archive; prepare rejects prior sessions/records/freeze; run rejects nonempty ledgers/execution/record roots, writes exclusive queue-start, uses one iteration per fixed model in Terra→Gemini order, stops after operational failure. New release must bind new freeze/catalog and supplement experiment with planned_mathematical_requests=2. Existing helper starts --ephemeral Codex / --new-project AGY with private per-session state.

checked_contracts.contract: Original evidence retained, no old response reuse
checked_contracts.evidence: Adoption checks the pinned original freeze, every archived file, completed final queue, zero unknown/integrity error rows, completed original comparison and matched offline replay. No old answer is inserted into the new request. This checks orchestration evidence, not independent mathematical approval; root adoption remains explicit.

runner_run is imported from math_gauge.execution.run and tested by object identity plus an actual local Python echo run. Both requests use the unchanged scripts/benchmark/cli_adapter.py, freeze timeout 2700 and runner timeout 2790. New script is hashed into the freeze and preflight bindings.

same_config checks requested model/effort, CLI client/version/bytes, deny roots, credential links, read exceptions and retained negative probes; fresh identity/inventory/config are bound. prepare runs fresh file-open/network probes. Actual adapter/execute_session verifies fresh parent/worker process policy, text-only event allowances, observed identity when provided, input counts, no retained credential links and raw response hashes. Unobserved backend model/effort remain unknown.

Supplement row starts at request_count=null; audit_case treats missing execution evidence as unknown. Only an untouched skipped session with empty ledger and no execution/run is recorded as zero. A launcher exception may use an actual integer 0/1 from execution evidence; absent evidence is not replaced by zero. The existing adapter may emit a zero default in an incomplete failure receipt, but audit_case does not qualify that incomplete case or promote its receipt default to known zero.

findings.finding: Original postprocess.audit still requires 41 completed Terra cases before the Gemini phase; archive calls this audit. A correct supplement has one completed Terra case, so the old global integrity check remains false. Do not call the old overall archive as if it supports this supplement.
findings.required_followup: Provide supplement-specific final integrity/archive handling based on the frozen 1-case/2-model plan without modifying the already frozen original code. Validate one successful paired synthetic archive and offline recomputation, plus a failed/unknown execution fixture.

findings.finding: collect_archive_files imports the original runtime/preflight-evidence and does not automatically archive the new supplement script, root adoption gate, fresh qualification/canary/proxy evidence or per-model execution-audit JSON. Reusing it unchanged would retain some stale preflight provenance and omit new supplement provenance.
findings.required_followup: Use an explicit supplement whitelist, preserve all new freeze-bound nonsecret evidence with mapped paths and hashes, exclude state/credentials, and include the supplement source plus shared comparison source. Preserve references to the old completed experiment as separate provenance. Offline replay itself is case-count-generic and can use the new two-run index and an empty Lean map for this written-only task.

findings.finding: Initial reviewed code lacked flat queue-start release/freeze hashes and emitted terminal-only progress. Author added the compatible flat hashes and phase-start/starting/terminal/phase-complete events. Static recheck and the updated targeted sequence test passed. This resolves event-schema observability but not the old 41-case check.

Current tests mock verify_release/audit_case for queue behavior and mock prerequisites for adoption rejection. They do not exercise a full valid archive/replay gate, same_config drift rejection, real session preparation, or final offline archive pipeline.
findings.required_followup: Use small synthetic evidence fixtures for the adoption/identity guards and future archive path; actual identity, policy and tool qualification must still be established in the explicit new preflight before release. Do not interpret these 8 synthetic tests as live CLI or model validation.

next_gate: Keep original experiment frozen. Complete original final archive/replay, adopt and verify new R005 material, prepare new preflight/session evidence, then root may review a new concrete release. Finish supplement-specific archive/offline replay before claiming end-to-end acceptance.
